title: Joyful Children Swimming in Pool, 1938 Fullerton California Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
747 A
FADE PROOF
AUG 29 1938
Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
description: Seven cheerful young children, boys and girls, Wade and splash together in a sun-drenched outdoor swimming pool on a warm summer day in late August 1938. The water glows brightly under intense sunlight as the children gather closely, smiling and laughing into the camera. Processed and developed by photo finisher B. D. Wood in Fullerton, California during the late Great Depression, this snapshot captures an enduring and carefree moment of American youth leisure.
